notes: Technical report on RefinedWeb and Falcon-RW 1.3B/7.5B (arXiv 2306.01116), not a system card. No model safety/alignment/honesty/jailbreak/bias benchmark numbers. Figure 4 is a dataset toxicity CDF chart (Perspective API) with no readable numeric table cells in the text layer, so no evalResults. Capability zero-shot aggregates (small-agg, main-agg, core, ext) and Wikitext perplexity skipped under safety-only pilot rules. Seed-linked tiiuae/falcon-rw-1b included; also covered checkpoint tiiuae/falcon-rw-7b named as Falcon-RW 7.5B. Bias topic left uncovered: web-stereotype limitation claim only, no bias test. Training date Dec 2022/Jan 2023 is not a model releaseDate.
